observation.text:
Augment with AlbumentationsX

General

Run settings are configured before individual augmentation stages.

Load pipeline

Choose a source, then explicitly replace the draft. Selecting a source alone keeps your edits.

​

Editable draft

Loaded from Saved pipeline: Editable flip baseline. Preview, run, and save use the values shown below. Every execution uses fresh randomness; loading from history does not replay an output.

Reload and replace draft

Review loaded annotations

Not restored at load time: detections (type changed: detections → classification); segmentations (missing or unsupported). Choose replacement fields below, or leave them unchecked to omit them. Annotations were matched by field name and label type. Other fields were left unchecked; review the selection below.

Execution scope

Choose whether to process selected samples, the current view, or the entire dataset.

​

Execution mode

Immediate execution is best for small bounded selections. Use delegated execution for views or datasets with about 50+ source samples to keep the App responsive and track progress.

Pipeline stages

​

Show 1-10 configurable stage slots.

Run label

​

Optional short prefix for generated run keys.

Outputs per sample

​

Dry run

Preview only

Render up to 3 selected samples in memory without creating samples, files, manifests, or custom runs.

Saved pipeline name

​

Optional saved pipeline name to save this pipeline.

Saved pipeline description

​

Save pipeline only

Save the current pipeline as a saved pipeline without running augmentation.

Compatibility

A compact preflight view for the current source scope, selected annotations, and pipeline.

Dataset compatibility

Scope: Current view; source samples: 1; selected samples: 0; schema: available. Annotations: 3 selected supported field(s), 2 transform-capable, 1 copy-only, 0 unsupported/excluded. Pipeline: HorizontalFlip; transforms renamed_masks, new_keypoints; copies detections.

Recommendations

For bboxes labels, filter transform capabilities by target bboxes before building presets.
For keypoints labels, filter transform capabilities by target keypoints before building presets.
Use Preview only on a small selection before materializing outputs for a new dataset.

Annotations

Checked fields are included in generated samples. Unchecked fields are omitted.

detections

Classification labels are copied.

renamed_masks

Detections labels use bboxes targets.

new_keypoints

Keypoints labels use keypoints targets.

Output metadata

Included annotations: detections, renamed_masks, new_keypoints.

Omitted annotations: None. Unchecked fields are omitted.

Omitted source sample fields: tags (including source tags).

Outputs receive new sample/label IDs, filepath, image metadata and output/run tags. Originals stay unchanged and are linked by albumentationsx_source_sample_id.

Label tags and custom scalar, list and object attributes are preserved. Per-point metadata keeps its joint indices.

Excluded on transformed labels: area, bbox_area, center, centroid, mask_area, num_keypoints, perimeter, segmentation_area. Other custom fields are copied as descriptive data; recompute any additional geometry-derived values.

Preview or dry run lists the exact unsupported or derived label attributes that will be omitted.
